## covariate adjustment
Set 3: gender_v1_v2 ,AGE_GOLD, bmi_v1_v2,  income_v1_v2,education, relocation_age, background_5, generation, AHEI   

## REgression function
```{r , echo=FALSE}


reg.func<- function(reg.results){

   #reg.results<- reg.1
reg.results%>%
  map(summary) %>%
  map(coef) -> m1.sum
reg.results%>%
  map(confint) -> m1.ci

m1.ci2<- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, m1.ci)) %>%
  mutate(cov=rep(row.names(m1.ci$shannon_s), 4)) %>%
    remove_rownames()%>%
 mutate(alpha=rep(names(m1.ci), each=nrow(m1.ci$shannon_s))) %>%
  dplyr::filter(cov %in% c('asthma.current:bmi_v1_v2','asthma.current:obese',  'bmi_v1_v2', 'asthma.current','obese'))
 
m1.sum2<- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, m1.sum)) %>%
  mutate(cov=rep(row.names(m1.sum$shannon_s), 4)) %>%
    remove_rownames()%>%
  mutate(alpha=rep(names(m1.sum), each=nrow(m1.sum$shannon_s))) %>%
  dplyr::filter(cov %in% c('asthma.current:bmi_v1_v2','asthma.current:obese', 'bmi_v1_v2', 'asthma.current','obese'))%>%
  dplyr::inner_join(m1.ci2, by=c('cov'='cov', 'alpha'='alpha'))
  #dplyr::select(-cov)%>%
  # mutate(alpha=rep(names(m1.sum), each=3))
results.to.return<- m1.sum2 %>%
  mutate( alpha=factor(alpha, lev=c( "observed_features_s",       "evenness_s" ,"shannon_s"   ,         "faith_pd_s"),
                                                  labels = c("Observed features",       "Evenness" ,"Shannon"   ,         "Faith's PD")))%>%
  arrange(alpha)%>%
  relocate(alpha)%>%
  #dplyr::select(alpha, Estimate, `Std. Error`, `z value`, `Pr(>|z|)`)%>%
  dplyr::rename(SE= `Std. Error`,t=`t value`, p.value=`Pr(>|t|)`, LCL='2.5 %', UCL='97.5 %')

return(results.to.return)
}


```


```{r , echo=FALSE}


alpha<- c('shannon_s','evenness_s', 'faith_pd_s', 'observed_features_s')

```




```{r , echo=FALSE}




map_regs_hei_int_bmi<- function(df) {
#df<- alpha.gold  
reg.4<-  df %>%
    dplyr::select(one_of(alpha)) %>%  
    map(~ lm(.x~asthma.current+bmi_v1_v2+ asthma.current*bmi_v1_v2+gender_v1_v2 +AGE_GOLD +income+education +relocation_age +generation+smoker.current.v1.v2+total+ AHEI2010, data = df))    


mod4.res<- reg.func(reg.4)

return(list(reg4=reg.4,mod4=mod4.res))
}

map_regs_hei_int<- function(df) {
#df<- alpha.gold  
reg.4<-  df %>%
    dplyr::select(one_of(alpha)) %>%  
    map(~ lm(.x~asthma.current+obese+ asthma.current*obese+gender_v1_v2 +AGE_GOLD +income+education +relocation_age +generation+smoker.current.v1.v2+total+ AHEI2010, data = df))    


mod4.res<- reg.func(reg.4)

return(list(reg4=reg.4,mod4=mod4.res))
}



map_regs_hei_as<- function(df) {
# df<- alpha.gold  
reg.4<-  df %>%
    dplyr::select(one_of(alpha)) %>%  
    map(~ lm(.x~asthma.current+obese+gender_v1_v2 +AGE_GOLD +income+education +relocation_age +generation+smoker.current.v1.v2+total+ AHEI2010, data = df))    

mod4.res<- reg.func(reg.4)

return(list(rreg4=reg.4,mod4=mod4.res))
}

```



```{r , echo=FALSE}

regs.hei.int<- map_regs_hei_int(alpha.gold)
regs.hei.as.ob<- map_regs_hei_as(alpha.gold)
regs.hei.int.bmi<- map_regs_hei_int_bmi(alpha.gold)

```


```{r , echo=FALSE}

res.all<- bind_rows(regs.hei.int.bmi$mod4 %>% mutate(Model='Int_BMI',exposure="asthma+bmi+asthma*bmi"),
                    regs.hei.int$mod4 %>% mutate(Model='Int',exposure="asthma+obese+asthma*obese"),
                    regs.hei.as.ob$mod4 %>% mutate(Model='Main',exposure="asthma+obese") )
```
